lines.t: Where does a law live before there is a world to obey it?
And if I reach the edge of space, would I reach the edge of anything?
Light on the ceiling till the oceans are blue
I'm lying awake while the walls fall through
Is distance a curtain, is time a door?
Would another dimension be creation still more?
Does spirit have somewhere, or is somewhere too small?
Can a creature leave matter and still meet a wall?
Not brick, not iron, not measurable height
A limit that answers to somebody's right
I can picture a thousand impossible skies
That doesn't make knowledge of what's in my mind
Maybe my questions are sparks in the dark
Not maps of the heavens, just signs of a hope
Hitherto shalt thou come, but no further
Was that only the sea, or am I hearing an echo of what it means to be created?
What has the watchman witnessed? A world that calls its hunger freedom. A king who cannot govern his own heart.
Did I hear that? Or did my conscience borrow stars to tell me what I wouldn't hear at home?
Watchers and angels, what do I know? Names on the page, and the questions still grow
Who kept their station? Who abandoned their place? What does rebellion look like face to face?
Am I joining what the text leaves apart?
Drawing old family trees from a fragment of spark?
A mystery isn't permission to claim
Every shadow I picture is given its name
If a spirit deceives, must it first be deceived?
Can it see what is holy and still choose to leave?
Not a rival creator, not another most high
Could a borrowed flame overthrow the sky?
The angels, which kept not their first estate
But left their own habitation
What if I cross?
Does crossing make you sovereign?
No
Now, a prisoner crossing a line hasn't abolished the law
Not another throne, not another source
No created will makes the maker change course
Who's who I am, above the seen, the unseen
What terror can crown itself over the king?
Why does my mind make a courtroom of space
And forget the rest of what I said, judgment's fate?
I imagine Cassandra behind judgment's face
I remember the wound and remember the night
And I rage for the pleasure of watching things break
What of the children, the hands that they take?
What of the cry that no palace lets through?
Would love to be loved if it never said no
For my wrath is born of sorrow
Says the Lord
And the deepest thing here
Isn't how far the heavens extend
It's that the one who could end my questioning
Would call a broken heart to mend
Why does the man keep looking upward?
Perhaps he thinks the answer
I must be far away
Then, in flesh, not escape from the body but flesh
The word entering, hunger and weariness
The hands that could touch, the feet that could bleed
How does the infinite enter our needs?
And the word was made flesh and dwelt among us
Not a man who stole heaven by climbing a stair
Not Babel succeeding, not pride getting there
Yahuwah in flesh, my category's banned
The glorified man our creation has sent
What I cannot contain, I will not cut down
Small, the risen one, speaking of power over all
All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth
Given, and nothing left outside the reach of it
At the edge of my imagining
Not the edge of who you are
I lay down my little kingdom
Every child and borrowed star
Yeah, who should I, yeah, who I
Glorify the risen king
Heaven is not your rival
You reign over everything
Not my theory, not my vision
Not the dream that carried me
Yours to throw me on my knowing
Yours the last authority
The ceiling's just a ceiling
The morning fights my face
I still don't know the shape of heaven
But I know I cannot take your place
